author: Top Gear
description:
This is the Kimera K39 – and it’s powered by a 1000hp Koenigsegg V8! Yes, you read that right: Kimera, known for its epic Lancia restomods, has teamed up with Koengisegg, Sweden’s hypercar royalty. It’s no restomod either, rather Kimera’s first production car, as the K39 has a bespoke carbonfibre chassis – and alongside the road car, Kimera is targeting the Pikes Peak Hill Climb with an even wilder racing version. All that goodness, plus modern-day Ferrari F40 vibes!

🚗 Kimera K39
